Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.240 of 2023 under Sections 498A, 304B IPC,
3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Singahi, District Lakhimpur Kheri.
3. In terms of the FIR registered on 09.11.2023, it was alleged that daughter of the informant was married to son of the applicant on 02.03.2021 and sufficient dowry was also given.
However, entire matrimonial family was demanding dowry and on 08.11.2023 an information was received that the daughter of the informant was admitted in a hospital.

sentences.text: 1 informant's daughter had administered poison to her.
4. In the light of the said allegations, the learned counsel for the applicant argues that no allegation was leveled at the time of inquest.
He also draws my attentions towards the post mortem report wherein cause of death could not be ascertained and viscera was preserved and sent for further analysis.

5. Considering the allegations in the FIR and on perusal of the post mortem report and other documents, there appears to be no allegation against the applicant of causing any physical or mental harassment to the deceased soon before her death in relation to demand of dowry, the applicant,
aged about 60 years, who is in jail since 29.04.2024, is enlarged on bail.
6. Thus the bail application is allowed.
